title: [Audit] System and hidden index access
description: Reads against .kibana*, .security*, .alerts-* and other dot-prefixed indices — privileged data access that deserves a second look.
esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | MV_EXPAND attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" | KEEP @timestamp, actor, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.request.name, client.ip | SORT @timestamp DESC
